narr: A trough of low pressure located over California moved slowly across Arizona. Large scale lift with the trough along with daytime heating to shower and thunderstorm over portions of central Arizona.
ev: Granite Creek in Prescott (GCRA3) rose around 4.15 feet between 445 PM and 615 PM. The waster began to decrease after 700 PM. A video posted on social media showed ongoing flooding in Granite Creek Park a mile north of Prescott Courthouse at 632 PM.
lsr: PUBLIC VIDEO ON TWITTER SHOWED ONGOING FLASH FLOODING OF GRANITE CREEK IN GRANITE CREEK PARK ABOUT A MILE NORTH OF PRESCOTT COURTHOUSE.
USGS GAGE GCRA3 (09502960) ROSE APPROXIMATELY 4.15 FEET BETWEEN 4:45 PM AND 615 PM MST. CREEK HEIGHT THEN BEGAN TO DECREASE AFTER 7 PM MST.
USGS GAGE GRCA3 (09503000) ROSE APPROXIMATELY 4.5 FEET BETWEEN 5 PM AND 7 PM MST. THE CREEK HEIGHT THEN BEGAN TO FALL AFTER 7.
